name: Yuncos (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, blue and yellow, the central blue stripe flanked by narrow white stripes and charged with the crowned arms of Yuncos.
history: The town council presented the flag project to the Real Academia de la Historia in June 2024 and it was finally approved by the Department of Finance and Public Administrations of Castilla-La Mancha in April 2025; the official description is a rectangular cloth divided vertically into three equal parts, the central one blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms and flanked by two vertical white stripes each a fifth of the width of the central part.

features.role: Yuncos arms — wheel and reeds on red above waves
